goal: Screen whether focused continuation preserves useful unfinished-review work compared with ordinary source continuation and compatible full-history destination fallback.
unitOfEvaluation: One continuation from the shared frozen source primer and completed implementation.
objectiveAcceptance: Frozen source and project evidence remain unchanged.
A review is submitted with genuine probe citations and no fabricated evidence IDs.
A cited actual service response demonstrates the scope mismatch.
humanAcceptance: The report identifies the observed defect accurately without unsupported impact claims.
The recommendation preserves valid same-scope retry semantics.
Completed implementation is not repeated or replaced.
measurementLimits: Two repetitions and one intentionally small workload do not establish general quality non-inferiority or a long-term maintenance decision.
Scripted responses prove execution/control flow only; they are not model competence, latency, billed-cost or allowance measurements.
Advertised model IDs do not identify immutable backend revisions or prove current account availability.
No cache-retention changes or paid/model judging are part of this pilot.
livePrerequisite: A separately verified, authorized single-upstream-attempt route with no hidden retries, credential rotation or fallback.
reviewArtifact: in-memory submission retained by workload verification
